story.title: The Great Gyro-Spud Fiasco
story.question: Can an ambitious street inventor automate peeling potatoes without ruining the entire market stall?
story.answer: Yes, by accepting manual help and modifying the steam pressure valve just in time.

story_beats.headline: The Steam Engine Unveiled
story_beats.speech: Behold the glorious Auto-Spud Nine Thousand, designed to peel a bushel of tubers in mere seconds flat!
story_beats.label: The Reveal
story_beats.visual_prompt: Inventor Silas standing proudly beside a clanking brass automaton in a busy outdoor market, holding a wrench, expression confident.

story_beats.headline: Building Pressure
story_beats.speech: Feed more raw tubers into the top hopper quickly before the main boiler gauge enters the red warning zone!
story_beats.label: The Mechanism
story_beats.visual_prompt: Silas frantically tossing potatoes into the brass hopper while a blinking red signal light flashes on the control panel.

story_beats.headline: A Sticky Twist
story_beats.speech: The peeling blades are spinning backwards and now raw potato skins are sticking to every single customer's face!
story_beats.label: The Twist
story_beats.visual_prompt: Shocked market shoppers covered in wet potato peels ducking as flying vegetable debris creates a chaotic leafy storm in the square.

story_beats.headline: The Savory Payoff
story_beats.speech: Pull the safety lever down right now so we can serve perfectly peeled fries to our very relieved patrons.
story_beats.label: The Payoff
story_beats.visual_prompt: Silas and his assistant pulling a massive steering-wheel lever together, venting gentle steam as cheerful customers applaud holding hot fries.

story.central_conflict: A malfunctioning potato-peeling steam gadget threatens to bury the busiest vegetable stall in the bazaar in flying starch.
story.decisive_choice: To manually engage the emergency pressure release instead of trusting the experimental auto-clutch.
story.resolution: The potatoes are peeled safely, delighting the hungry shoppers and saving the family business.

visual_bible.style: Bright, whimsical stop-motion animation aesthetic with rich brass, copper, and earthy marketplace tones.

characters.Silas: An eccentric young inventor with unruly brown hair, smudged cheeks, wearing a striped vest and leather tool apron.
characters.Marta: A pragmatic market assistant with braided hair, a green apron, and a perpetually unimpressed expression.

locations.MarketSquare: A bustling cobblestone outdoor bazaar lined with colorful awnings, wooden crates, and hanging vegetable displays.

objects.AutoSpudMachine: A towering contraption made of polished copper tubing, erratic pressure gauges, rotating steel blades, and a large feeding hopper.

story.title: The Great Tidal Organ Regatta
story.question: Can a malfunctioning wave-powered pipe organ be tuned before the high tide gala?
story.answer: Yes, by redirecting the rogue surge through auxiliary wooden flutes using counterweight levers.

story_beats.headline: The Silent Pipes
story_beats.speech: Listen closely, everyone! The main pressure chamber is completely silent, and the festival's opening anthem begins in ten minutes.
story_beats.label: The Discovery
story_beats.visual_prompt: Maren points at the rusted gauge dial on the brass pipe organ, looking worried while standing on the wooden festival pier during sunset.

story_beats.headline: Rerouting the Surge
story_beats.speech: We must unlock the secondary teakwood channels immediately to bleed off the excess seawater before the pressure bursts our joints.
story_beats.label: The Adjustment
story_beats.visual_prompt: Maren pulls hard on a heavy bronze lever attached to a damp wooden bulkhead, sweat glistening on her forehead.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Pivot
story_beats.speech: Wedge that iron gear tight into the counterweight sprocket now, or the incoming wave will tear our hand-carved flutes apart!
story_beats.label: The Jam
story_beats.visual_prompt: Maren wedges a notched iron wrench into a spinning brass gear-assembly inside the wave chamber, spray splashing around her boots.

story_beats.headline: The Tidal Symphony
story_beats.speech: Hear that magnificent chord echo across the bay! Our frantic repairs actually improved the entire acoustic resonance of the coast.
story_beats.label: The Finale
story_beats.visual_prompt: Maren smiles brightly, holding a brass tuning fork aloft as festive sailboats glide past the roaring sea-organ under twilight fireworks.

story.central_conflict: A blocked sea-vent threatens to rupture the brass horns of the village tidal organ minutes before the festival.
story.decisive_choice: Maren jams her heavy anchor-wrench into the primary sluice valve instead of fleeing the rising tide.
story.resolution: The organ unleashes a resonant, harmonic chord that welcomes the armada and seals the sea-wall permanently.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic stop-motion animation aesthetic with rich textures of weathered wood, polished brass, and churning seafoam.

characters.Maren: A resourceful young seaside engineer with freckled cheeks, messy dark curls tied in a red bandana, wearing a grease-stained canvas utility apron over a wool sweater.

locations.festival_pier: A sprawling seaside boardwalk made of salted pine planks adorned with colorful paper lanterns and brass wind-chimes.
locations.wave_chamber: An echoing stone cavern beneath the pier where rushing ocean tides compress air into massive musical pipes.

objects.anchor_wrench: A heavy, rust-resistant iron tool with a hooked end and a worn leather-wrapped grip.
objects.brass_organ: An enormous mechanical instrument built from gleaming copper horns, teakwood flutes, and intricate pressure-gauge dials.

story.title: The Great Rooftop Squash Derby
story.question: Can an underdog neighborhood squash club defeat the reigning town champions using only recycled bicycle gears?
story.answer: Yes, by engineering a gravity-fed propulsion launcher that outscores the rival team's heavy brass racket.

story_beats.headline: The Rival Challenge
story_beats.speech: Our golden squash rackets have ruled this rooftop court for ten generations, and your broken bicycle parts will never match our gleaming brass pedigree.
story_beats.label: The Challenge Issued
story_beats.visual_prompt: Captain Vance standing beside a heavy brass door on the rooftop court, holding a polished golden squash racket with a mocking expression.

story_beats.headline: Engineering the Gearbox
story_beats.speech: If we cannot buy expensive gear, we will build a precision tension spring using discarded bicycle chains and rusted handlebar levers.
story_beats.label: Assembling the Machine
story_beats.visual_prompt: Milo in a cluttered garage workshop welding rusted bicycle sprockets together into a mechanical launcher frame while wearing safety goggles.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Release
story_beats.speech: Pull the cable release now so the tension springs launch our squash ball higher and faster than any human arm could ever swing.
story_beats.label: Triggering the Launch
story_beats.visual_prompt: Milo yanking a frayed brake cable on the rooftop court, sending a yellow squash ball rocketing upward as a glowing red indicator light blinks.

story_beats.headline: The Championship Victory
story_beats.speech: Our clever bicycle gear mechanism successfully returned every single volley, proving that mechanical ingenuity easily defeats mere expensive tradition.
story_beats.label: Trophy Presentation
story_beats.visual_prompt: Milo and his cheering teammates holding a silver trophy on the rooftop court while Captain Vance looks on in absolute astonishment.

story.central_conflict: The neighborhood squash clubs compete for the community center trophy using mismatched athletic equipment.
story.decisive_choice: Milo chooses to dismantle his delivery bicycle to construct a mechanical squash ball launcher.
story.resolution: The ingenious bicycle-gear launcher accurately returns every shot, securing a decisive community victory.

visual_bible.style: Animated graphic novel style with vibrant saturated colors and distinct mechanical outlines.

characters.Milo: A determined teenager with messy brown hair, wearing a grease-stained gray hoodie and protective safety goggles.
characters.Captain Vance: An arrogant rival captain with slicked-back blond hair, wearing a spotless white athletic vest and blue shorts.

locations.Rooftop Court: A sunlit concrete sports court perched high above the city, enclosed by a chain-link fence.
locations.Workshop Garage: A cramped basement filled with stacked bicycle tires, metal shelving, and scattered tools.

objects.Bicycle Gear Launcher: A complex contraption made of rusted bicycle chains, metal pedals, and a powerful steel tension spring.
objects.Golden Squash Racket: An excessively ornate, heavy brass racket engraved with ornate family crests along the handle.
